trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide:
1. Nothing to hunt here: it fires when the other 54 are registered [1][2].
2. All 55 are offline, so no multiplayer is required [1].
3. Treat the Gold A Long Road as the real gate and work the five stages in order [1][3].

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide:
1. Just play the opening mission, Gone Fishing; the trophy arrives with it [1][2].
2. It is automatic and cannot be missed [2].
3. Story trophies stay hidden on PlayStation until earned, so expect it to appear only then [3].

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide:
1. Clear the first mission of Chapter 1 and this one comes in on its own [2][1].
2. GTABase marks it unmissable [2].
3. No special choice or medal is involved [1].

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide:
1. Start Chapter 2 with What's in the Bag? and the trophy pops [2].
2. PowerPyx lists it as an automatic story unlock that cannot be missed [1].
3. Nothing optional gates it [3].

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide:
1. Finish Chapter 2; the trophy lands as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City [2].
2. PowerPyx notes it is automatic [1].
3. A previous manual save at the chapter boundary is enough to replay it if needed [1].

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide:
1. The Chapter 3 close-out pays this trophy off after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life [2].
2. It is automatic and cannot be missed [1].
3. No collectible or side activity is involved [3].

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide:
1. Finish the story's last main mission, Starting From Zero, and the Gold arrives [1][2].
2. Free roam continues afterwards, so every cleanup trophy remains available [1].
3. There is no New Game+ and no mission replay, so save before the finale [1].

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide:
1. Complete Breakfast Run in Chapter 2; the trophy follows the mission [2][1].
2. It is an automatic story award and cannot be missed [2].
3. Keep a chapter-boundary save as a precaution [1].

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide:
1. The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3 awards this trophy on completion [2][1].
2. No grading or optional objective changes the unlock [1].
3. It is listed as unmissable [2].

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide:
1. Finish Child's Play in Chapter 4 and it unlocks automatically [2][1].
2. There is no alternate outcome to chase [1].
3. The trophy is not missable [2].

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide:
1. Clear Headliners in Chapter 4 for this story trophy [2][1].
2. It is automatic; nothing in the mission is flagged for a trophy by the guides [1].
3. It cannot be missed [2].

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide:
1. The VCIA Takedown mission in Chapter 4 hands this one over automatically [2][1].
2. No special approach is documented by the sources [1].
3. It cannot be missed [2].

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide:
1. Play Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5; the trophy follows the mission [2][1].
2. All twelve story trophies are automatic and unmissable [4].
3. Save at the chapter start and end, since there is no mission replay [1].

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide:
1. The Gold for the in-game 100% checklist, hidden until the story ends and then found under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion [1][2].
2. Work done during the story already counts [2].
3. Only five categories need everything: robberies, underwater finds, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's hunts; most other lines need only a share (300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base vehicles, 15 of 18 meditations) [2][3].
4. PowerPyx calls it closer to 60% true completion and says nothing on the checklist is missable [4][2].

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide:
1. Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, in any mix [1][2].
2. Under-the-bridge flights are the fastest way to stack them [2].
3. The optional challenge attached to a stunt is not needed; performing it once is enough [2].
4. Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts; 100% asks for 300 [1][3].

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide:
1. Try each of nine activities once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, an arcade game, a race win and a stunt [1][2].
2. A single basket is enough for basketball [1].
3. Progress > Activities shows which types are still outstanding [2].
4. Most are introduced by the story or appear as the map opens up [2].

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide:
1. Gold-medal every shooting-range challenge: 42 golds across 12 challenges at two ranges, Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Range north-west of Vice City [1][2].
2. Buy the $5 Waiver Pass from the clerk so challenges appear on the map; rented weapons will do [3].
3. Play as Lucia at Griffin, where she runs faster, and bank the permanent Focus upgrade each finished challenge grants [3].
4. All 42 are also a 100% requirement [4].

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide:
1. Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; one win per site is enough [1].
2. Some sites charge an entry fee [2].
3. Find them under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones [2].
4. The 100% checklist is stricter: all 42 time trials across the 14 sites [2].

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide:
1. Win 20 different races; repeating the same one does not advance the count [1][2].
2. Track the set in Touch Pad > Activities > Racing [2].
3. Most race locations let you hire a car, so a fast ride is never far away [2].
4. For 100%, aim at 30 unique wins rather than 20 [3].

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide:
1. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, Cal texts you and marks a fishing spot [1][2].
2. Work through his favours, then beat him in the fishing challenge to earn the trophy [1].
3. Push Square specifies a Parrotfish over 2 kg in the marked area, so bring a boat with a rod (hijack one nearby if needed) [3].
4. Nothing about this quest is flagged as missable [2].

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide:
1. Finish any one arcade game from start to end; its side challenges are optional [1][2].
2. Three games - Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind - are on the home TV from Chapter 1, while Bang For Your Buck sits on cabinets around Leonida [2].
3. The TV is unavailable during some story sections but works again after the story [2].
4. All four games are needed for 100% [3].

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide:
1. Andy's text with a Belville address starts this Lucia-only strand in Chapter 3 [1][2].
2. Do the five jobs in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass for the trophy [1].
3. All remain available after the story [1][2].
4. Push Square simply records it as the end of Andy's mission chain [3].

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide:
1. Kenton hires you from the green KR icon in Key Lento in Chapter 1 to loot seven shipwrecks [1].
2. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig up the treasure [1].
3. He leaves briefly and texts Jason later, so this is not missable; calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds the return [2].
4. Check Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures [1].

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide:
1. Find Billy at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break [1].
2. Work through five jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes [2].
3. The fifth awards the trophy [1].
4. The chain stays open in post-story free roam [1][2].

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide:
1. Finish eight qualifying stranger strands; confirmed counters are Kirk (3 quests), Kyle (3), Yago (4) and Pilot Pete (5) [1][2].
2. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy [1][2].
3. None of these are part of 100%, so they are pure cleanup [2].
4. All remain available after the story [1].

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide:
1. Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 unlocks the Key Cloner and Randy's Wish List [1].
2. Deliver the 16 listed sports cars to his west Vice City garage, marked RK [1].
3. Use WAiNK to check cars against the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are productive, and better condition pays more [1].
4. The full car list is on PowerPyx; the chain is still open after the story [2][3].

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide:
1. This is Jason-only and opens after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 [1].
2. Destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City [1].
3. The order is Take Out Kitty Litter, then Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), which awards the trophy [2].
4. Push Square marks it as the end of Tyrone's missions [3].

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide:
1. Meditate at all 18 spots; each one counts on the Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations counter [1].
2. Doing a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and the final spot needs both characters after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 [1].
3. The Chapter 1 balcony scene with Lucia, the morning after Down to Earth, is the risk: accept her meditation before the chapter ends [1][2].
4. That scene is not marked like the other spots and its effect on the trophy is unconfirmed, so treat it as possibly missable [1][2].
5. A meditation only completes at the final zen animation [3].

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide:
1. Bret texts Jason after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, starting with Veteran Hunted in Lummox County [1].
2. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks and bring them back as Jason; a clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required [1].
3. The sources do not name the exact triggering animal, so the safe route is all 15 decks - they are required for 100% anyway [1][2][3].
4. His first quest awards the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle [2].

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide:
1. Complete any three Collectible Card sets; 18 sets and 480 cards exist, and 15 sets are needed for 100% [1][2][3].
2. Cards are picked up in the world and cannot be farmed by buying them [2].
3. Selling duplicates at a pawn shop does not remove cards from Collections [2].
4. Track the sets under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards [3].

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide:
1. Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the phone app (D-pad Up, then R1); any 100 count [1][2].
2. Categories include 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures plus No Flusher tags [1].
3. The counter lives under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations [3].
4. The same 100 scans are a 100% checklist line [4].

trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide:
1. Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; finished ones get a tick in Progress > Challenges [1].
2. Many clear themselves during normal play [1].
3. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so it pays to leave the hardest ten until last [2].
4. The PSN counter tracks the same total [4].

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide:
1. Once free roam as a pair opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner (D-pad Right, then Triangle) [1][2].
2. Pull a 4-star wanted level and break out of the red heat zone - leaving the flashing search area alone is not enough [1].
3. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the simplest hiding place [1][2].
4. Bank vault jobs hand you four stars for free [1].

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide:
1. With your partner, rob three shops in a row without losing the wanted level [1][2].
2. Take body armour, sticky bombs and healing items [1].
3. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after Yasmani's Chapter 3 Jewelry Jobs, sit close together [1].
4. The trophy usually pops about 30 seconds after the third shop; rob a fourth if it does not [1][2].

trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide:
1. Scan 100 different vehicles with WAiNK; you do not need to drive them [1].
2. Simply getting inside a vehicle also discovers it [2].
3. Stand beside a busy road and scan passing traffic to speed the count [1]. 557 vehicles exist at launch, and 100% asks for 200 of the 277 base models [3][4].

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide:
1. Fill Focus first - eating, drinking or washing at home helps, and Adrenaline extends the window [1].
2. In a crowded gang operation, click both sticks while aiming to pop Combat Focus and drop five enemies inside a few seconds [1][2].
3. An assault rifle makes this practical [1].
4. Gang-operation thugs count, while soldiers, police and civilians appear not to [1][2].
5. Focus has four levels and rises through ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots [2].

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide:
1. Steal a passenger jet connected to a departure bridge gate at VCIA; jets parked on the airfield do not work [1][2].
2. Gates E3 and E4 are easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the stairs-side door [1].
3. Back the jet out, take off and fly roughly 1 km from the airport [1].
4. The unlock is delayed until you clear that distance [2].

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide:
1. Head to Mile Zero Air Station on the south-west island of Mariana County, where tanks sit at the southern end of the base [1][2].
2. Enter by driving through the gate or using the stunt jump by the south-east entrance [2].
3. Steal a tank and get kills from inside it until the trophy fires [1].
4. No mission trigger is required [1].

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide:
1. The Snap Gun arrives with the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which also opens jewelry-store robberies [1][2].
2. Pick the locked back door with the Snap Gun - kicking it in trips the alarm [1].
3. Find the safe-code note in the back room and empty the safe without being seen [1].
4. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well [1][2].

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide:
1. Vaults open through the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is [1].
2. Tail a security van to its bank and enter while the vault is open; the haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner [1].
3. Every vault raises four stars - escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles; each can pay up to $205,000 [1].
4. Yasmani sells van tips after two Payday Loans jobs; 22 bank jobs exist, 14 small banks and 8 vaults [1][2].
5. All eight vaults are needed for 100% [4].

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide:
1. Box in an armored truck, stick a bomb on its back doors, blow them and get clear [1].
2. A bank-vault robbery also counts as long as you then escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray [1].
3. Both routes are available in post-story free roam [1].

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide:
1. Clear the fog from all 52 Leonida areas; a plane is the fastest way to sweep every dark patch [1][2].
2. The six headline regions are Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga [3].
3. The in-game counter records the same total [2].
4. Exploration is cumulative and survives the story ending [1].

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide:
1. Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icon) from each of the nine gangs; Progress > Gangs keeps the tally [1].
2. There are 39 operations in all, and 100% wants every one [2][3].
3. Only one per gang is required for this trophy [1].
4. The source list of all 39 sites is on PowerPyx [2].

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide:
1. The description points to a cocktail at a viewpoint on Ocean Beach in Vice City [1].
2. GTABase says the exact steps are still unconfirmed, and SixShore agrees [1][2].
3. Try the oceanfront bars early, note the viewpoint, and check back after the story if nothing fires [1].
4. Because the method is one unconfirmed scene rather than a repeatable counter, treat it as possibly missable until a trigger is pinned down [2].
5. The trophy appears on the official list as a hidden award [3].

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide:
1. The wording suggests crashing a car out through a vehicle showroom window in classic style [1].
2. GTABase explicitly says the exact steps are not confirmed yet [1].
3. SixShore files it among the hidden trophies whose methods are unsettled [2].
4. Work through car showrooms and try a high-speed exit rather than trusting any single scripted location [1].
5. Recheck the sources before spending hours on one spot [1][2].

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide:
1. Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation first marked in Chapter 2; because the robbery returns later, it is not missable [1][2].
2. Take the three valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table and the safe in the north-east hallway (bring sticky bombs) [1].
3. The trophy pops once you lose the police, and the valuables do not need to be taken in one visit [1].

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide:
1. Max the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia in the character menu [1].
2. Work out at fitness clubs with your partner present: training one trains the other too, and home workouts become available after the story [1].
3. SixShore confirms that working out together advances both [3].
4. Note a source conflict: GTABase marks this trophy hidden while GTA6 Field Guide marks it visible [1][2].

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide:
1. Build up 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile; most players reach this without trying [1].
2. Switch on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch the tally [1].
3. The PSN counter reads 0/500 at the start [2].
4. Avoid the Irredeemable profile while grinding - it is permanent and makes police more aggressive [1].

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide:
1. "Second time's the charm" hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something [1].
2. GTABase says the exact steps are not confirmed, and PowerPyx suspects a link to a Payday Loans store [2].
3. Try replaying Payday Loans jobs and second-chance activities before assuming a rare world event [2].
4. Do not treat any single location as the confirmed trigger [1][2].

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide:
1. The description teases a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida [1].
2. GTABase says the method is unconfirmed; PowerPyx suspects a UFO questline [2].
3. Explore unusual landmarks at odd hours and follow up any odd encounter [1].
4. No source confirms a fixed mission or location [1][2].

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide:
1. The wording points to knocking people over with a melee hit thrown from a moving vehicle [1].
2. GTABase says the exact trigger is not confirmed, while PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle [2].
3. Try melee hits from bikes and cars against pedestrians, then move on if nothing registers [1][2].
4. No confirmed location exists in the sources [1].

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide:
1. The Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) provides the Dye Pack Jammer [1].
2. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most [1][2].
3. It is a running total, so the robberies already needed for 100% get you there [1].
4. PSNProfiles tracks the same counter; IGN instead lists $100,000 for the checklist, so follow the trophy text of $250,000 [3][4].

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide:
1. Spend $100,000 across all shops on a running total; guns, car mods and tattoos burn through it fastest [1].
2. Shops are marked under Touch Pad > Style [2].
3. Push Square calls this possibly the easiest trophy in the list [2].
4. The PSN counter tracks the same figure [3].

trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide:
1. Buy the eight garages listed in the Vice City Real Estate phone app, available after Chapter 2's Daily Driver; the four story garages do not count [1].
2. Prices total about $160,000: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000, 7th Avenue $12,000, Vela Rota Drive $24,000, Persistence Road $7,600, Wyatt Motors $21,600, Bonita Court $34,000, Atlantic Court $40,000 and Store n' Bolt $16,800 [2].
3. The counter reads 0/8 on PSNProfiles [3].
4. Buying property also frees garage space for On the Spot [1].

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide:
1. Moses' Chapter 2 mission hands over the Scooter Bros app [1].
2. Take stolen vehicles to his Port Gellhorn garage, respray and register them [1].
3. At first he accepts only cars without trackers; from Chapter 3 any Pay 'n' Spray can register tracked cars [1].
4. Fees vary with vehicle value, so use cheap cars and bikes, and have free garage space first [1][2].
5. The PSN counter reads 0/10 [3].

stages.title: Story run
stages.focus: 12 story trophies unlock automatically. Save at each chapter start and end; there is no mission replay and no New Game+.

stages.title: During the story
stages.focus: Seed the countable side work as it opens: Cal, Kenton, Billy, Andy, Bret, Randy, Tyrone, vehicles, map fog and the Chapter 1 meditation.

stages.title: 100% checklist
stages.focus: Clear the everything-required categories first - robberies, underwater finds, shooting ranges, drone races, Bret decks - then the partial counters.
stages.counts: 42 range golds · 42 drone races · 39 gang ops · 22 bank jobs

stages.title: Partner & crime cleanup
stages.focus: Call your partner for the wanted-level and shop trophies, then sweep crime, combat and the unconfirmed hidden triggers.

stages.title: Platinum
stages.focus: The Platinum lands as the 54th trophy is registered. No extra playthrough, no online requirement.
